visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a middle-aged male host wearing a black button-down shirt and silver-rimmed glasses. White text headers are visible at the top and bottom of the frame. The host uses energetic hand gestures while speaking directly to the camera. (2) A screenshot of a scientific research article titled 'Dual-cycle CO2 fixation enhances growth and lipid synthesis in Arabidopsis thaliana' is overlaid on the screen. The host remains visible in a smaller frame or beneath the text. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio setting. (3) The scene shifts to a detailed 3D molecular model of the RuBisCO enzyme, represented as a complex cluster of blue and orange spheres. The host points to specific areas of the model while explaining its function. Yellow and white variety-style text labels appear periodically to emphasize scientific terms. The host stands to the side of the diagram, using a pen to gesture toward specific parts of the metabolic pathway. (5) A side-by-side photographic comparison of plants is shown. On the left are smaller, natural 'WT' plants, and on the right are significantly larger, lusher 'MCG' genetically modified plants. A ruler is visible at the bottom of the plant pots to show scale. (6) The host returns to a center-frame medium shot, concluding the explanation. He holds a blue pen and continues to gesture with both hands. The animated mascot background remains consistent, and a final call-to-action graphic for channel membership appears at the top.
